methodologyAndLimits: All 193 country cards on publisher PDF pages 6–9 independently extracted by coordinates, including published 2026 rank, 2025 rank and score.
Rank movement calculated from the two publisher rank values; arrows in PDF text extraction are font glyphs, not numbers.
Ten-point score bands are app-derived. Public perceptions survey scope, not an objective absolute quantity of diplomatic power.

Nineteen absent movement values are completeness gaps, not false numerical claims. Guatemala is the only provided movement that disagrees: app -4 versus source 120 to 126 = -6. Rendered PDF page 8 confirms the card visually.
